title: Between Vs Among Vs Amid
theory:
 Between: Used when referring to two people or things. (nks yksxksa ;k phtksa osQ chp@nks osQ fy,)
     Among: Used when referring to more than two people or things. (nks ls vf/d yksxksa@phtksa
         osQ chp)
     Amid: Used with uncountable nouns to show "in the middle of" a situation, emotion,
         environment, etc. (fdlh fLFkfr] Hkkouk ;k ekgkSy osQ chp)

      Note
     Between is used for more than two when there is a clear individual relationship/separation.
     Ex. The treaty was signed between India, Nepal, Bhutan and Bangladesh.
     Ex. Cooperation between the police officers, doctors and local volunteers saved many lives
     during the flood.
